attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: ParserNormalForm(EF+EqSAT+SR_h): prove that every short proof of LB(H_N^{SAT}) either gives a dense functional label property, an occurrence/full-row transcript, or a bounded-SR residual code with advice-free size bound poly(|pi|,L_N).
steps: Fix Psys_h=EF+EqSAT+SR_h and the beta-zero carrier H_N^{SAT}.
Recheck the target bridge: substituting any SIZE(L^c) SAT circuit into all generated queries gives C(H_N^{SAT})<=N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)}, so q,rho<1+epsilon is the target-preserving exponent condition.
Expose the SR semantic escape by allowing h rounds of SAT self-reduction before labels are evaluated.
Given a leaf solver A_N of size N^{tau+o(1)}, compute each top query by enumerating 2^{bh}=N^{eta_N+o(1)} leaves, OR their A_N labels, and XOR over M_N=N^{q+o(1)} queries.
This yields C(H_{A,h})<=N^{rho+o(1)}+N^{q+eta_N+tau+o(1)}.
If H_{A,h} differs from H_N^{SAT} on E_N rows, add equality patches for those rows and get C(H_N^{SAT})<=N^{max{rho,q+eta_N+tau,1+e}+o(1)}.
Therefore any claimed N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} source lower bound must rule out all bounded-SR easy carriers with q+eta_N+tau<1+epsilon and e<epsilon.
Attempted extension to full EF+SAT semantics: EqSAT quotienting is parsed by identifying label variables, and explicit SR rules add OR hyperedges.
The extension fails for arbitrary EF extension variables because they may encode global SAT-semantic predicates not representable as bounded SR leaf evaluations or occurrence-row queries.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The derivation proves a valid restricted-model falsifier and necessary robustness condition. It does not prove the source lower bound, does not resolve P vs NP, and does not classify arbitrary EF+SAT_U proofs without the blocked parser normal form.

assumptions: Circuit lower bounds are nonuniform Boolean circuit lower bounds over source length N; P/poly target circuits are nonuniform but the reduction from a SAT circuit to H_N is uniform.
The beta-zero regime means L_N=(log N)^d, hence L_N^c=N^{o(1)} for every fixed target exponent c.
The row-error set R_N={x:H_{A,h}(x) != H_N^{SAT}(x)} has size E_N=N^{e+o(1)} and is charged by equality patches of O(N) gates per row.
The SR parser branch is conditional: the proof transcript must expose only EqSAT quotienting and bounded SR OR constraints; arbitrary EF semantic extension variables are not yet covered.
The source lower-bound claim under audit is C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}; the lemma is a route falsifier, not a proof of this lower bound.
definitions: source object: H_N^{SAT}(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), |x|=N, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, formula length L_N=(log N)^d with d>1, and generator circuit size N^{rho+o(1)}.
target object: SAT notin P/poly, obtained only route-conditionally from a valid source lower bound C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} when q,rho<1+epsilon and L_N=N^{o(1)}.
controlled interface: beta-zero batched substitution plus a parsed EF+EqSAT+SR_h transcript represented by EqSAT quotient labels and h rounds of self-reduction OR constraints over generated formulas.

target-preserving condition: the generator and parser are uniform, q,rho<1+epsilon, every leaf solver and residual patch is charged to the source circuit budget, and no nonuniform advice is hidden in the proof transcript.

Psys_h is EF augmented with formula-equivalence axioms EqSAT and explicit self-reduction clauses SAT(F)=OR_a SAT(F|a) for h rounds fixing b variables per round on formulas reachable from the generated range.
eta_N=b h/log N is the SR expansion exponent, so the number of leaves per queried formula is 2^{bh}=N^{eta_N+o(1)}.
A_N is a leaf-label circuit of size N^{tau+o(1)} on the h-round restricted formulas, and H_{A,h} is the parity carrier obtained by OR-evaluating A_N on all SR leaves for each generated query.

equations.valid_when: Valid when SAT has size L^c circuits on all generated length-L_N formulas and L_N=(log N)^d makes every fixed c contribute only N^{o(1)} overhead.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If q+eta_N+tau<1+epsilon and e<epsilon, the claimed source lower bound is falsified; if no parser exposes bounded SR leaves, this lemma remains a restricted-model audit only.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is the cycle-90 inference-quality theorem packet: a concrete bounded-SR semantic falsifier and quantitative threshold for proof-mediated beta-zero XOR certificates.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For the beta-zero SAT parity carrier, any bounded self-reduction leaf solver whose induced parity carrier is wrong on fewer than N^{epsilon-o(1)} source rows gives a subthreshold circuit for H_N^{SAT}. Thus a Psys_h proof route using EqSAT plus h-round SAT self-reduction is valid only after certifying constrained residual distance against these induced easy codewords.

assumptions: The certificate is functional over the constrained label space: acceptance depends only on quotient labels satisfying the named EqSAT and SR clauses.
The parser returns the relevant SR constraint DAG with size at most N^{o(1)} times the proof length, or else the statement is not applicable.
The lower-bound threshold is the same N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} threshold used by the beta-zero target bridge.
definitions: source object: the actual SAT label vector on formulas in the generated h-round SR closure.
target object: residual robustness of H_N^{SAT} against all subthreshold SR-induced carriers.
controlled interface: EqSAT quotient labels plus SR OR constraints, measured only through the induced source-row parity function.
target-preserving condition: the easy carrier family is label-independent except for the charged leaf circuit or transcript, and the row patching cost is included.

equations.label: easy_distance_obligation
equations.valid_when: Valid as a necessary condition for any parsed bounded-SR certificate that purports to rule out all source circuits below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A single SR-induced carrier with circuit size below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and row distance below N^{epsilon-o(1)} is a falsifier.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Necessary robustness condition for the SAT-semantic branch of the extraction fork.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Define EasyDist_h(S) as the minimum row distance from H_N^{SAT} to any parity carrier induced by an EqSAT-consistent h-round SR leaf assignment whose source circuit size is at most S. A valid Psys_h lower-bound certificate for C(H_N^{SAT})>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} must imply EasyDist_h(N^{1+epsilon-o(1)})>=N^{epsilon-o(1)}.

assumptions: EqSAT axioms are nonrelativizing formula-semantic principles and cannot be simulated by independent occurrence-label flips.
SR axioms are also nonrelativizing because they enforce OR consistency among related formulas.
The proof system is fixed before seeing the SAT label vector; otherwise the certificate model leaks advice.
definitions: source object: a concrete EF+EqSAT+SR_h proof pi of a lower-bound sentence LB(H_N^{SAT},N^{1+epsilon}).
target object: a fork-resolving extraction/no-go theorem for the formula-semantic proof behavior.
controlled interface: proof parsing into truth-table functional tests, occurrence row queries, or EqSAT/SR constrained residual codes.
target-preserving condition: the parser must be advice-free, polynomial in proof length, and must not assume occurrence locality unless derived.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: An EF derivation using extension variables for global SAT-semantic predicates outside EqSAT/SR_h blocks the parser and demotes the theorem to the restricted Psys_h model.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Top proof-delivery open lemma; it states the exact blocked extraction needed before broad claims about full EF are valid.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For EF+EqSAT+SR_h, the desired parser theorem would map every short accepted proof of the H_N lower-bound sentence either to a dense functional label property, to an occurrence/full-row transcript, or to the bounded-SR residual audit of C90.L1-C90.L2. attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: ExtensionRowRealizer_subst is unproved for arbitrary EF SAT_U atoms; SAT-composition can hide global row dependence inside one extension formula.
steps: Fix pi and close its SAT_U atoms under extension substitution, equality, and composition to obtain semantic row support K_pi.
Assume ExtensionRowRealizer_subst: from pi and K_pi compute an advice-free D_N of size N^{1+o(1)} agreeing with H_N^SAT on all rows not in K_pi.
Patch the remaining K_pi rows by truth-table DNF over x, costing O(|K_pi|N), and compare with LB_N.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: Named blocked lemma WExtTranscriptInduction(P_wExt): the rule-by-rule proof must be written for the exact proof-system grammar used in the draft, especially parity binding, extension-variable congruence, and quotient-witness verification.
steps: Fix P_wExt syntax: EF extension rules, local SAT_U occurrence axioms, local parity rules, and witnessed extensionality rules carrying quotient/congruence witnesses.

Define the induction invariant I(t): after t proof lines, every label used by the derived row-parity assertion is represented by an occurrence transcript plus equality quotient with cumulative adaptive-cover exponent at most alpha_t.
Check base rules: generator lines cost N^{rho+o(1)}; local SAT occurrence labels are opened through the transcript at total cost N^{q+alpha_t+o(1)}.
Check EF extension rules: definitional variables are added as local gates and do not create new semantic formula identity; they only increase the local opener by N^{o(1)} under the declared cover.

Check witnessed extensionality: the supplied quotient witness contracts formula occurrences; its summaries/openers are charged to alpha_ext, so the induction invariant survives exactly when the witness is checkable and advice-free.
Define ForcedRows as rows whose parity is invariant over all completions respecting Q_pi/E_pi; nonforced or unbound rows are placed in F_N, and semantic mismatches are placed in R_N.
Construct D_N by computing G_N, opening all M_N labels through Q_pi/E_pi, xoring the labels, and patching rows in F_N union R_N by hardwired truth-table bits.
Add sizes: generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}, label simulation N^{q+alpha_ext+o(1)}, and patches O((|F_N|+|R_N|)N), yielding the stated upper bound.
Compare the upper bound with the claimed lower-bound threshold N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}; if the maximum exponent is below 1+epsilon, the carrier claim is refuted.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The packet is a restricted-model theorem sketch with a precise exponent ledger. It is not yet a full proof because the actual strong proof system may contain unwitnessed SAT-extensionality or global semantic rules, and row-parity binding must be verified rather than inferred from ordinary soundness.

assumptions: Source model: P_wExt is a Cook-Reckhow style proof/certificate model; every accepted proof is polynomial-time checkable from the proof string and the public generator description, with no advice and no hard-row selector.
Length regime: M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, each SAT instance G_N(x,j) has polylogarithmic length, and G_N is computable by circuits of size N^{rho+o(1)}.

Cover regime: the extracted quotient/transcript has alpha_ext=max{tau,max_l(a_l+mu_l),max_l omega_l}+o(1), so all queried labels are simulated by N^{alpha_ext+o(1)}-size openings per SAT-query family.
Binding regime: outside F_N union R_N, the row parity computed from the transcript equals H_N^SAT(x); |F_N|<=N^{f+o(1)} and |R_N|<=N^{r+o(1)}.
Circuit model: the target upper bound is nonuniform unrestricted Boolean circuits over the N-row truth table domain; hardwiring exceptional rows costs O(N) gates per row.
Uniformity/advice status: pi, Q_pi, E_pi, F_N, and R_N are obtained by an advice-free parser from the public proof/certificate, although the final contradiction circuit itself is nonuniform.
Non-claim boundary: this proves a scoped upper-bound falsifier for low-cover carriers only; it does not prove P != NP or a lower bound for H_N^SAT.
definitions: source object: A P_wExt proof pi or certificate transcript for the beta-zero SAT-parity family H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), with explicit row-parity binding claims.
target object: A same-length unrestricted Boolean circuit for H_N^SAT, used only to refute an overstrong carrier lower-bound claim and not as a proof of P != NP.

controlled interface: The parser extracts an occurrence transcript Q_pi, a witnessed equality quotient E_pi, a forced-row set F_N, and a residual set R_N; E_pi is charged by adaptive-cover exponent alpha_ext.

target-preserving condition: The extraction is uniform and advice-free, keeps the original generator G_N, query count M_N, and row length N, and charges every formula-identity step to an explicit quotient witness rather than an unwitnessed semantic oracle.
P_wExt rule: an extensionality step may identify formula occurrences only when a polynomially checkable quotient/congruence witness is included in pi.
ForcedRows(pi): rows whose parity is syntactically constant over all local completions compatible with Q_pi/E_pi.
ResidualRows R_N: rows not covered by the binding argument and patched individually in the final circuit.

candidate_lemmas.statement: Witnessed-extensional beta-zero parser theorem, restricted form: For the proof system P_wExt=EF plus local SAT_U occurrence axioms plus witnessed formula-extensionality rules, any accepted low-cover row-parity certificate for H_N^SAT yields an unrestricted circuit upper bound C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ext,max(f,r)+1}+o(1)}.
